faqs.question: What are your services?
faqs.answer: We offer Web Development, Digital Marketing, Graphic Design, and Video Production services. We help businesses create stunning websites, boost their online presence, design compelling visuals, and produce engaging video content.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: We are located in Kathmandu, Nepal. You can contact us through our website or reach out directly for more specific location details.

faqs.question: How can I contact you?
faqs.answer: You can contact us through our contact page on the website, or click 'Talk to a person' below to connect via Facebook Messenger or WhatsApp for immediate assistance.

faqs.question: Do you offer courses?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer various courses including Digital Marketing, Web Development, Graphic Design, and Video Production. Check our Courses section for detailed information and enrollment.

faqs.question: What are your pricing plans?
faqs.answer: Our pricing varies based on the service and project requirements. Please contact us for a custom quote tailored to your specific needs.

faqs.question: Can I see your previous work?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can check our Portfolio section to see examples of our work across web development, digital marketing, graphic design, and video production.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Project timelines vary depending on complexity and scope. Simple websites may take 1-2 weeks, while complex projects can take several months. We'll provide a detailed timeline during consultation.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept various payment methods including bank transfers, online payments, and digital wallets. Payment terms will be discussed during project initiation.
